Anya: Heads up — after the int4 bring-up of ranky3b-v2 I'm seeing a sizable NDCG@10 regression on webdocs_v2_holdout.
Marco: numbers?
Anya: Float16 baseline NDCG@10 = 0.386, int4 = 0.349. MRR@1 0.241 -> 0.198. Regression concentrated on queries >120 tokens and multi-paragraph docs.
Priya: did you confirm the tokenizer artifacts are identical between runs? quant toolchain sometimes pulls a different vocab/normalization.
Anya: yes, same tokenizer artifact. Also noticed more tied scores and unstable top-k ordering after quant.
Sam: can you produce a per-slice breakdown (len buckets, answer_density, candidate_count)? Also run an int8-hybrid compare if possible.
Anya: kicked off a focused slice run: ```python -m eval.rerank --model ranky3b-v2 --quant int4 --holdout webdocs_v2_holdout --slices "len>120" --out /tmp/int4-slice.json```
Marco: check kvpack/prefixcache interplay — long docs + kvpack + quant kernels can change KV eviction timing and effective context seen by the scoring pass.
Priya: also run an anchor (gold) set of ~2k queries. If anchor NDCG is stable, this looks like dataset/format sensitivity, not universal model breakage.
Anya: dropping 3 short fail examples here for quick eyeballing:
- Anya: SAMPLE A: query "how to set up two-factor auth for rails app" — baseline top doc contains step-by-step, int4 returns short generic paragraph; doc ids: baseline=doc_34, int4=doc_509
- Anya: SAMPLE B: long legal Q with inline bullets — int4 prefers short passage mid-doc, baseline picks full statute section
- Anya: SAMPLE C: multi-paragraph product spec — ordering flips between baseline and quant consistently
Alex: triage plan I recommend: 1) float16 vs int4 per-slice; 2) int8-hybrid experiment (matmul quant only); 3) run with kvpack disabled; 4) fix candidate ordering seed and re-eval; 5) evaluate with `--seed 42 --no-batch-fuse`.
Lina: add a tokenization diff check to rule out subtle bpe shifts: `diff -u baseline.toks quant.toks | head -n 50` and paste any mismatches.
InfraBot: deploybot: started staging job cluster=rank-staging-3 job=eval-1920009876 at 2026-03-22T14:03:12Z :gear:
Anya: thanks all — I'll run the int8-hybrid and kvpack-off jobs and post results in ~2 hours. :thumbsup:
